title: Collective superintegrable systems from the Guillemin--Sternberg torus action
summary: We present a novel approach to the superintegrability of collective Hamiltonians invariant under a Hamiltonian action of a connected semisimple compact Lie group, $G$, on a symplectic manifold, $M$.
